summary: Community Financial System, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the completion of its acquisition of ClearPoint Federal Bank Trust, a federally chartered savings association and leader in trust administration for the death care industry. The deal, originally announced January 14, 2026, was effected via merger with Community Bank, N.A., a wholly-owned subsidiary. ClearPoint has over $1.5 billion in assets under management and a historical three-year revenue CAGR of 9.7%. No financial terms, price per share, premium, or advisors were disclosed. The acquired business will operate as ClearPoint Trust, a division of Community Bank. Watch for integration updates and revenue contribution from Nottingham Financial Group.
